notes.hook: Strong, counterintuitive hook about accidental death of a record-holder.
notes.clarity: Narrative is linear and easy to follow with one clear idea per beat.
notes.payoff: The reveal of the exact age and historical context (Ming dynasty) is satisfying.
notes.visuals: Generally good, though the ship/submersible images are a bit generic.
notes.loop: Perfect seamless loop back to the start.

rounds.better_than_last: This is the first Short, establishing a high bar for narrative flow and loop execution.
